title.suggested: Republic Defends Tom Allen's Move to Stop Daly-McManus Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic chided 'Deacon Houser's paper' (the Globe-Democrat) for protesting Tom Allen's interference with the Daly-McManus prize fight, noting that Allen was himself a reformed prize-fighter.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, December 9, 1888, page 4 (editorial page).

facts.fact: Allen's attempt to stop the Daly-McManus prize fight drew a protest from the Globe-Democrat, which said the fight should go on

notes: The end of the item is in the next column and cannot be read at page.jpg resolution; recrop to include it. D. M. Houser was president of the Globe Printing Co. (Globe-Democrat), per the masthead in article 762.
